_assumptions.JUMP_REFERENCE: Jumps are calculated from the 'last_visited_node' (typically a leaf) of the previous tree to the root of the next tree. This simulates the microscope moving continuously to the next fragment.
_assumptions.JUMP_BIN_SIZE: Set to 10.0 micrometers. A 10.0 bin size provides an optimal balance, creating a manageable vocabulary size for cross-tile spatial gaps while retaining enough resolution for the language model to learn connectivity.
